return_semantics: spot next-action dS and expiry-matched delta-hedged option dH=dC-delta*(S_expiry-S_trade), without transaction costs
roundoff_semantics: 32 times float32 unit roundoff applied to the unreduced arithmetic scale

importance_sampling.proposal: mixture of the direct-P Gaussian path and exact conditional Gaussian bridges with one widened future log-spot marginal

realized_log_variance_control.definition: sum of squared daily log-spot changes along each path

query_sampling: at most one uniformly selected action time from each direct-P base-mixture path; query states are therefore unweighted P draws

option_tail_coverage_training.definition: proposal counts and likelihood-weighted original-P probabilities; positive/negative refer to the long expiry-matched delta-hedged return beyond its float32 roundoff band

option_tail_coverage_validation.definition: proposal counts and likelihood-weighted original-P probabilities; positive/negative refer to the long expiry-matched delta-hedged return beyond its float32 roundoff band

zero_adverse_single_instrument_policy.definition: At each query state, among directions with zero adverse outcomes in the training-neighbour sample, select the one instrument/direction with the largest estimated favorable part and use unit L1 exposure; otherwise do not trade.

conditional_moment_signal.definition: directional E[dH|z] exceeds g times the population conditional standard deviation estimated from the same uniform k-nearest-neighbour sample

neighbor_radius.metric: Euclidean distance after training-only componentwise standardization
